title: TrimAchievements
description: Adds collection-based achievements for armor trim templates. Find, collect, and use every template to complete your set and progress through the system.
body: This mod adds a collection-based achievement system focused on armor trim templates. Players are encouraged to find, collect, and use every template in the game, turning smithing into a progression journey. Each achievement represents a step toward completing the full set, making exploration and discovery more rewarding.
